1.0.label = The Light Mortar
1.1.label = Intro 1.1.alert.modal = A team of light mortarmen can make short work of fortified enemy infantry, create a wall of smoke allowing friendly units to advance across open fields, and pummel attackers from behind cover.
1.2.label = Firing Position 1.2.alert = Move forward to the firing line.
1.3.label = Deploying the Mortar 1.3.alert = The mortar must be deployed on the ground. Go prone now by pressing {fpprone}.
1.4.label = Deploying the Mortar (cont.) 1.4.alert = Deploy your mortar by pressing {fpdeploy}.
1.5.label = Using Your Map to Locate Targets 1.5.alert = An effective mortarman must be able to accurately determine the distance to their target. With practice you can learn to estimate this distance. For now, press {showingamemap} to view your map. 1.5.complete.modal = Your map will show enemy locations marked by your team mates. It can also give you an idea on the distance to nearby landmarks, such as roads and buildings.
1.6.label = Determining Range 1.6.alert.modal = Zoom in on your map and take note of the ring surrounding your location. This ring extends 200 meters around you in all directions. Using this ring can be a very effective range finding tool. 1.6.alert1.modal = The mortar has an effective range from 50 m all the way to 500 m. Aim at the tank in the down range and adjust your range to 100 m with {gunsightrangedec}.
1.7.label = Practice Firing the Mortar 1.7.alert = When you are ready, fire a HE round by pressing {fpfire}. 1.7.complete.modal = Notice the delay from loading the mortar to the time the round hits the target. This makes the mortar not the ideal weapon for attacking moving targets. However, a team of mortars firing at scattered ranges in a small area can be devestating to stationary enemies behind cover or in the open.
1.8.label = Providing Cover 1.8.alert.modal = Having a team of mortarmen available to provide cover is a huge benefit to front line infantry assaulting a position. Along with HE rounds for devastating enemy fortifications and sniping positions, mortarmen are armed with smoke mortars perfect for turning an open field from a vulnerable kill zone into a cloud of concealing smoke. These same smoke rounds can also be used to help friendly tanks and aircraft locate enemy targets. 1.8.alert = Take a moment to switch to SMK mortar with {fpweapon1} and practice deploying smoke cover. 1.8.complete.modal = Remember that smoke works for both sides. Be careful not to draw attention to yourself when you are otherwise concealed and the enemy is not aware of your position.
1.9.label = Mortar Tips 1.9.alert.modal = Mortarmen are also armed with a rifle which can be selected with {fpweapon2}. However, every mortar round and rifle clip is precious. It is a good idea to move with riflemen who have ammo packs available. You can request ammo by typing /ammo in the chat box.
1.10.label = End Tutorial 1.10.alert.modal = Congratulations! You have completed the light mortar tutorial. Feel free to continue practicing by selecting "Cancel" in the despawn window. Additional ammunition is available at the supply truck.
